title: [Poderer] Endfield: I think
description: Added ponder for the Endfield Industry mod, based on the Ponderer mod.
body:
# Endfield: I think（终末地工业：俺寻思）

## English
Adds pondering functionality to [Endfield Industry](https://modrinth.com/mod/endfield-industry). Requires the [Ponderer](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-ponderer) mod to be installed.

### How to Use
1. Install the [Ponderer](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-ponderer) mod.
2. Place this resource pack into your game's `resourcepacks` folder and enable it in-game.
3. Open any world, press the shortcut key (default: `V`) to open Ponderer's settings menu, then click "Reload Resource Packs".
4. If the chat displays "Loaded XX files from Endfield-Ithink", the resource pack has been successfully loaded! You can now start pondering about Endfield machines.

### Notes
- Some features may still be incomplete. Feel free to contact the author for feedback: [bilibili@红石镐](https://space.bilibili.com/1632691253) or QQ: 3183659401.

## 中文（简体）
为[终末地工业](https://modrinth.com/mod/endfield-industry)添加了思索，需要安装[思索者](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-ponderer)模组。

### 使用教程
1. 安装[思索者](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-ponderer)模组。
2. 将本材质包安装到游戏的 `resourcepacks` 文件夹，并在游戏里加载它。
3. 打开任意一个存档，按下快捷键（默认：`V`）打开思索者的设置界面，点击“重载资源包”。
4. 如果聊天栏显示“已从Endfield-Ithink重载XX个文件”，材质包就加载成功了！接下来你就可以对着终末地的机器寻思了。

### 注意事项
- 本材质包可能会有不完善的地方，可联系作者（[bilibili@红石镐](https://space.bilibili.com/1632691253)、QQ3183659401）进行反馈。
